precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "planning_private_4b888090" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "planning_private_4b888090" ON "public"."operation_records" AS RESTRICTIVE FOR SELECT TO PUBLIC USING (kind NOT IN ('RESOURCE_PLAN','WEATHER_ANALYSIS') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=operation_records.organization_id AND m.user_id=nullif(current_setting('vops.user_id',true),'')::integer AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.role IN ('ORG_ADMIN','COORDINATOR')))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"
